stem: Which sequence best supports a defensible routine meter measurement?
choices: Verify meter readiness, rinse/prepare as required, measure a representative sample, allow the reading to stabilize, record the result and relevant context
Measure first, calibrate afterward only if the result seems unusual, then rewrite the first value
Use any available container, mix standards with samples, and record the lowest value
Skip verification when yesterday's meter check passed
rationale: Measurement quality depends on meter readiness, contamination control, representative sampling, stabilization, and complete documentation.
